# Public API

Read and write your organization's data models and records from scripts and other systems, over REST with an API key. A key acts as its owner and can never do more than they can.

The public API is off until it's turned on for your organization; whoever runs your Monark instance does that.

- [Make your first API call](make-your-first-api-call.md): create a key, check it, and create a record from the command line.
- [Create a key with limited access](create-a-key-with-limited-access.md): give an integration only the permissions it needs, or its own service account.
- [Page through results](page-through-results.md): read every record in a model, page by page.
- [Handle errors and rate limits](handle-errors-and-rate-limits.md): retry when throttled and report what you can't fix.

Every endpoint, error code and limit is in the [Public API reference](../../reference/public-api.md).
